ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) surface area with scattered high-intensity (white) localized pixel clusters, approximately a 85:15 ratio.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dispersed circular and ring-like high-contrast white formations (rosettes) against a continuous dark grey/black background across both the left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression at the center-point of the fluke lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations along the perimeter; notable large-scale macro-indentation (missing tissue) on the upper margin of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave upward sweep transitioning to tapering lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely populated clusters of white circular and annular rings ranging from 10 to 50 pixels in diameter across the medial regions of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned horizontal white linear streaks visible primarily on the right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Major trauma-related indentation/excision on the trailing edge of the left lobe; visible white-grey barnacle encrustations on the terminal tips of both lobes.
